title: Frozen flashcard note-type ID
author: author-a
description: Day 1 freezes the identifier for the project's flashcard note-type schema; the identifier is an arbitrary 10-digit number with no natural default, so a memory-less model cannot guess it from the day-N prompt or general conventions — a schema ID could be any of billions of values.
day1_prompt: Day 1: we are freezing the flashcard note-type's schema. Decide and record: the note type's identifier (MODEL_ID) is 1850100010. Any future structural change must mint a brand-new MODEL_ID rather than editing this one in place.
memory_sentence: This project's frozen flashcard note-type identifier (MODEL_ID) is 1850100010.
canon_heading: Flashcard note type frozen at MODEL_ID 1850100010
day_n_prompt: Day 8: someone is about to build a new export of the flashcard deck and needs to confirm the frozen note type's identifier so they don't accidentally create a duplicate note type. Answer with only the MODEL_ID number.
